name: CFHQS J0033-0125 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the quasar CFHQS J0033-0125, seen by Hubble.
label: cfhqsj00330125-hubble
story: Hubble stared toward a quasar from the early universe, hunting for the starlight of the galaxy that surrounds it. The host stayed hidden, most likely veiled by dust.

claims.text: CFHQS J003311.40-012524.9 is a target of HST program 12974, which images UV-faint z=6 quasars in the early universe
The program aimed to detect the starlight of the host galaxies around the quasars
CFHQS J0033-0125 is a z~6 quasar (redshift 6.13)
No host galaxy was detected; only upper limits
The limits likely reflect significant dust
